notes: «- يعني ابن عبد الكريم -» and «- يعني ابن عقيل بن منبه -» are editor glosses, left out (rule 1).
«سألت جابرا» makes جابرا a link: the asker (وهب) transmits the answer of the one asked (rule 5).
«وأنه سمع النبي» names the Prophet, the end of the chain; the subject of «أنه» (Jabir or the Thaqif speaker) is left as the text has it.
